_about: The six lines every voice candidate renders (core/scripts/expressive/). 'text' is the plain line; 'tagged' the same with the nonverbal tags a model that supports them gets ([laugh] style is rewritten per model); 'cue' is the feeling, which Kokoro's quick wins map to speed and a sound effect (config/cues.json); 'exaggeration' is Chatterbox's emotion dial for it.

lines.text: Wait, you finished the whole thesis already? How did you pull that off?
lines.tagged: Wait, you finished the whole thesis already? How did you pull that off?

lines.text: Ooh, you got the internship! That's amazing, I knew you would!
lines.tagged: Ooh, you got the internship! That's amazing, I knew you would!

lines.text: Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field! Ha!
lines.tagged: Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field! [laugh]

lines.text: Oh... I'm so sorry about your grandma. Take all the time you need.
lines.tagged: [sigh] Oh... I'm so sorry about your grandma. Take all the time you need.

lines.text: Wait, what? Your roommate is a chess grandmaster?
lines.tagged: [gasp] Wait, what? Your roommate is a chess grandmaster?

lines.text: A stack is last in, first out. You push onto the top, and you pop from the top.
lines.tagged: A stack is last in, first out. You push onto the top, and you pop from the top.
